page.overview:
Who is Wind Sky Entertainment?

Wind Sun Sky Entertainment, was the former company that animated Invincible of Season 1.

Originated in Vancouver, Canada, Wind Sun Sky Entertainment was established around 2016, two years before the Invincible comic's end run. Wind Sun Sky made a couple animated shows called Future Chicken and PSI Cops, two of which was a 3D animated series.

In 2019 to 2021, Wind Sun Sky worked on Invincible, their most notable moments in the series by fans and critics alike have been the Omni-Man destroying the Flaxan planet, The Guardians of the Globe vs Omni-Man, and Machine Head's Crew, The Hammer satellite firing down on Omni-Man and Invincible vs Omni-Man fight.

Following 2022, Skybound Entertainment would take over the series key frames.
